sources.approvedMagpie: IP设计/最终选稿（喜鹊）/11-紫色小喜鹊-平面数字伙伴版.png

eyeAssembly.importRule: Preserve SVG ids as Rive object names; clip iris, pupil and highlight with their matching sclera clip.

rigStrategy.reason: The approved source exists only as PNG. A vector/image-mesh hybrid preserves the approved painted look while keeping eyes, mouth and joints continuously controllable.

qualityGates: Near eye remains visibly larger than far eye.
Blink closes with lids; never squash the whole eye.
Pupil and highlight never leave the sclera clip.
Default gaze matches the approved source before animation.
No baked checkerboard, halo or drop shadow in imported assets.
